ios.desc:
EggHead: Discover, Learn, and Explore the World, One Article at a Time

EggHead is the ultimate app for curious minds! Dive into a never-ending stream of fascinating short-form information across a wide range of categories—from history and science to pop culture and technology. Whether you’re a trivia lover or a knowledge seeker, EggHead delivers a personalized learning experience that grows with your interests.

Key Features:

Endless Exploration: Swipe through a continuous, infinite feed of information. The more you read, the more EggHead tailors your feed to match your preferences.
Personalized Recommendations: EggHead intelligently adapts to your reading habits, showing you topics and categories you love while introducing you to new subjects you might not have discovered otherwise.
Multi-Category Support: From arts and sports to science, geography, and beyond—EggHead brings you summaries from a wide variety of fields, ensuring there’s always something interesting for everyone.
Fast, Focused Reading: With short, digestible article summaries, EggHead lets you quickly absorb information without overwhelming you with details. Perfect for on-the-go learning!

quotes.text:
Hey HN!

There was a lot of interest in WikiTok [1] today, so I figured I'd share a similar iOS app I've been building for fun over the last little while.

It's pretty simple - an endless feed of summarized Wikipedia articles generated by an algorithm that tries to learn what the user is actually interested in reading.

Check it out!

[1] https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=42936723
